title: Metric rename + smoothing tweak caused autoscaler to under-provision EU dedicated tenants
creator: Aisha Khan
description:
Summary: On 2026-03-10 we received multiple customer escalations from EU tenants (notably MediQ and FinSight) reporting repeated burst failures and elevated 503/429 responses despite apparent reserved headroom. Immediate investigation showed the dedicated autoscaler was not prewarming reserved slots for small/medium tenants in the eu-west cluster window, causing sustained capacity shortfalls during morning peaks.

What happened (high level): During a staged runtime deployment earlier that week we shipped two changes that interacted unexpectedly: (1) a telemetry rename in the warmup pipeline (metric 'tenant_warmup_weight' -> 'tenant_warmup_delta') intended to clarify semantics, and (2) a smoothing parameter tweak in the autoscaler (alpha 0.30 -> 0.03) to reduce noise for long-tail tenants. The autoscaler change included a short-lived metric mapping layer that failed to apply for a subset of scale-controller replicas in EU due to a config roll ordering bug. As a result the scale controller undervalued current warmup progress for many small tenants and deferred scale-ups. This was amplified by a concurrent maintenance job (slot-reclaimer) that reclaimed idle warm slots in eu-west to free space for a provider patch, further draining available warm capacity.

Immediate customer impact: High - customers experienced degraded SLA (increased latency, request shedding, and failed bursts) for 30-50 minute windows during regional peaks. Several Prod-facing accounts opened high-severity tickets and on-call paged SRE/Platform.

Evidence: Dashboards show warm_slot_count trending down while pending_burst_requests rose, autoscaler headroom_estimate fell despite queued demand, and a config diff timestamps line up with when some scale-controller pods received the new mapping while others did not. Relevant artifacts are linked below.

root_cause: A combination of (1) a telemetry metric rename shipped without an exhaustive rollout guard, (2) an aggressive smoothing parameter change that reduced autoscaler responsiveness for small tenants, and (3) a configuration roll ordering bug which left a subset of EU scale-controller replicas reading the new metric name without the mapping shim. The mismatch caused warmup progress to be undercounted while the slot-reclaimer maintenance reclaimed warm slots, producing a rapid headroom shortfall.
actions_taken: Emergency mapping shim and headroom bump applied to eu-west
Suspended slot-reclaimer maintenance during recovery window
Merged hotfix that enforces metric mapping loading and prevents smoothing alpha from falling below safe floor for small tenants
Rolling restart of scale-controller replicas in eu-west to ensure consistent config
Added autoscaler_warmup_mismatch_high alert and updated runbook sequencing rules

(Owner: Aisha) Expand canary gating: require mapping validation across 3 replicas in eu region before full flip (estimate 2)
(Owner: Platform) Add preflight check to prevent slot-reclaimer/maintenance jobs from running during scale-controller config changes (coord with infra ops) (estimate 5)
(Owner: SRE) Create dashboard slice for small-tenant warmup responsiveness and alerting thresholds (estimate 2)
(Owner: Eng Leads) Re-evaluate smoothing alpha tuning and publish recommended safe floors per tenant size class (estimate 3)
